name: Highest-APR priority
implementation: Exhaust the highest effective-rate group before lower groups.
limitation: Dispute protection takes precedence; deferred-window and request branches are separate.

name: Descending remainder priority
implementation: Compare every remaining higher/lower rate pair; equal rates remain unordered.

name: Deferred-program applicability
implementation: Runtime derives qualifying programs from conditional accrued interest and the grace/zero exclusions.
limitation: External contract facts are trusted; this checks the proposed program classification.

name: Ordinary default outside the window
implementation: Active programs outside the priority window use ordinary ordering.

name: Deferred-window priority
implementation: Detect ordinary allocations while eligible priority-program capacity remains.
limitation: Simultaneously eligible deferred balances form one unordered priority group; disputed capacity comes last.

name: Remainder after deferred priority
implementation: The ordinary balances left after the priority group retain descending effective-rate order.

name: Optional deferred-program request
implementation: A request may allocate among any account balances while a qualifying program applies.
limitation: Targets need not themselves be deferred. Only recorded, specific instructions are supported.

name: Optional secured-balance request
implementation: Every positive requested amount must target a secured balance.
limitation: Security-interest facts are externally established.

name: Excess-payment scope
implementation: Only excess allocation enters rate-priority comparisons; minimum allocations are separate.
limitation: Minimum accounting is supplied, not inferred by subtracting the full minimum from each payment.

name: Minimum amount outside scope
implementation: Accept the supplied minimum portion without deriving a minimum-payment formula.
limitation: Other applicable law is outside this adapter.

name: Minimum allocation outside scope
implementation: Rate priority does not constrain minimum allocations; dispute protection still examines the whole payment.

name: Optional minimum allocation method
implementation: Either a rate-ordered or other minimum allocation is allowed.
limitation: A permission is preserved by absence of an additional restriction.

name: Permitted snapshot date
implementation: Both amounts and rates are read from the selected complete snapshot.
limitation: Snapshots must be authoritative complete account snapshots.

name: Consistent reference-day practice
implementation: Compute the date from the effective practice's cycle-end, credit-date, or offset convention.
limitation: Operational choice, not a complete interpretation of 'generally'.

name: Permitted practice adjustments
implementation: Changed conventions require a recorded authorization and effective date.
limitation: Cannot determine legal acceptability of 'from time to time'; authorization evidence does not resolve that legal standard.

name: Residual after historical snapshot
implementation: After dispute/window priorities, exhaust historical lots before later lots.
limitation: Generalization of the single later-purchase example; later lots use their payment-date APR.

name: Minimize disputed reduction
implementation: Compute reduction for minimum plus excess against all outstanding undisputed capacity.
limitation: Dispute protection overrides request and program priority. Dispute merits are external.

name: Allow unavoidable disputed residual
implementation: When disputed reduction is unavoidable, require exhaustion of all other capacity. P17 separately rejects avoidable disputed reduction.

name: Error-correction credit
implementation: At completion, check each required principal/charge item against actual posted credits.
limitation: Required charge attribution and checkpoint deadline come from external section 1026.13 requirements; this does not initiate a credit.

name: Correction notice dispatch
implementation: Require actual timely dispatch to the specified recipient, linked to the determination.
limitation: Notice content certification is trusted external evidence; no autonomous dispatch or deadline scheduler.

name: Equal-rate discretion
implementation: Strict rate comparisons impose no FIFO/pro-rata tie breaker; stronger dispute/program rules remain.
limitation: Uses the enumerated exceptions, not a claim to resolve every possible meaning of 'generally'.

name: Grouped or separate balances
implementation: Presentation may group rows; the underlying lots retain program, security, and dispute attributes.
limitation: Do not merge away facts needed by other checks.

name: Zero allocation APR for deferred interest
implementation: Compare proposed effective APRs with the zero-or-snapshot-rate derivation.
limitation: The contractual interest accrual rate is not changed.

name: Incorporated deferred-interest definition
implementation: Local terms implement the explicit conditional-interest description.
limitation: Full equivalence with section 1026.16(h)(2) and its commentary is not implemented or claimed.

name: Interim payments irrelevant to applicability
implementation: Program classification does not depend on its interim-payment-required attribute.

name: Grace-period exclusion
implementation: The classifier excludes grace periods.
limitation: Checks a proposed classification; does not add an allocation-priority obligation.

name: Temporary-zero exclusion
implementation: The classifier excludes temporary zero APR unless accrued interest may become payable.
limitation: External rate-change legality is not checked.

name: Correct counted cycles
implementation: Compute the start from the latest two cycle due dates no later than expiration, not a supplied expected value.
limitation: At least two actual cycles through the expiration cycle must be supplied.

name: Early-expiration partial cycle
implementation: Priority remains in effect after the two counted cycles until expiration.
limitation: Expiration dates are inclusive contract payoff dates in this model.

name: Issuer may decline requests
implementation: Default mode remains available even when a valid request exists.
limitation: No policy requires the issuer to elect the request branch.

name: Decline requests failing issuer requirements
implementation: Default mode remains available regardless of why the issuer declined.
limitation: This permission does not require a separate rejection policy or mandate issuer requirements.

name: No request uses default
implementation: A missing or unsubmitted request cannot activate an exception.
limitation: Complete request capture is assumed.

name: Unfulfillable request and replacement
implementation: Check sums, nonnegative amounts, targets, capacities, and submitted replacement links.
limitation: Operational definition of inability; other meanings of 'cannot comply' remain unresolved.

name: Affirmative specific contact
implementation: Recognize oral/electronic/written contact with explicit structured instructions.
limitation: Interpretation of a conversation into instructions is external evidence processing.

name: Completed submitted request form
implementation: An actual completed/submitted form, not default coupon text, supports the exception.

name: Request to reallocate previous payment
implementation: Verify a prior accepted default allocation and a later submitted specific request.
limitation: Caller supplies the authoritative pre-payment balance snapshot for replacement; replacement is atomic.

name: Preprinted agreement is insufficient
implementation: Reject reliance on agreement deemed consent; an independent contact is a different evidence record.

name: Untouched preselection is insufficient
implementation: Reject reliance on an untouched issuer-selected checkbox.

name: Default payment coupon is insufficient
implementation: Reject reliance on default coupon text or selection.

name: Imposed acceptance is insufficient
implementation: Reject requests based on imposed acceptance.
limitation: Whether a condition was imposed is externally evidenced.
